title: Assessment of Epigenetic and Transcriptomic Signatures During Induced Neural Stem Cell Conversion of Human Blood Cells
description: Cellular reprogramming by direct cell fate conversion has been shown to be associated with epigenetic de-aging. However, the dynamics of this process still remain elusive. Here, we generated induced neural stem cells (iNSCs) from erythroid progenitors of donors ranging from neonatal to 101 years of age by overexpression of the transcription factors SOX2 and MYC. First, performing DNA methylation analyses, we corroborated our previous finding that iNSCs generated from aged donors show pronounced epigenetic de-aging (data deposited as GSE295849). Studying the dynamic of epigenetic de-aging during iNSC conversion across time, we found that this process is largely protracted.
